title: Enforcers an adapter vouches for in a host (data, never code)
description: A taken adapter's declaration of the enforcers a MUST may name that the adapter can find in the host (ADR-024): every key of the object at `pointer` in the host's JSON file `path` whose value is not empty is accepted as `<prefix>:<key>`. A key the host does not declare is no enforcer. The kit's core names no product; the product's name is this document's `prefix`.
